PDF_Summary: The PDF is a presentation for a CLO-SET Skill-Up Webinar in 2022. It discusses the features and workflow of CLO-SET, a 3D creation workspace that maximizes the value of 3D assets for communication and collaboration in design and product development. The presentation covers various aspects of the CLO-SET workflow, including planning, 3D asset creation, design review, editing and adoption, decision making, and production. It highlights features such as group structure, permission system, annotation, color configurator, comment visual board, company library, line sheet, and more. The presentation also mentions the current roadmap and future plans for CLO-SET, including trend data comparison, style positioning, better forecasting, unlimited storage, file compatibility, and metaverse integration. Overall, CLO-SET aims to streamline communication, data utilization, and collaboration in the design and product development process.
